description: Step 1 of AI 3D generation on the user's connected PrintPal account. Validates the prompt or attached image, quality and format, and returns the exact credit cost, the account's available credits, normalised settings and a short-lived quote_token. Nothing is generated or charged. Show the user the cost and settings, then call generate_3d_model only if they agree. Text: pass `prompt`. Image-to-3D: pass the attached image as `image` (prompt is then an optional label). Qualities, cheapest first: super (768³, the default), superplus (1024³), superplus_1280, superplus_1536, superplus_2048 and superplus_2048_master (the most detailed and most expensive). Geometry tiers export stl/glb/obj/fbx; their *_texture variants add colour textures and export glb or obj (obj arrives as a zip). Every tier accepts a text prompt or an image; an image gives the most faithful result, and a text prompt adds about a minute to make a reference image first. The 2048 tiers return 5M-face files and take 10-20 minutes. prepare_3d_generation returns the exact credit cost.

image.description: An image the user attached in the conversation (PNG, JPEG or WebP).

download_url.description: Temporary download URL supplied by the host.

image_url.description: For clients without file attachments: an https URL of a PNG/JPEG/WebP image.

prompt.description: What to generate, e.g. "low-poly seated fox figurine". Required without an image.

name: prepare_3d_generation
